intro: GrintByte is a digital products studio. We design and build independent software products, extensions, and integration platforms for the systems modern businesses already rely on.
story: GrintByte started from a simple observation: most businesses do not need another platform, they need the platforms they already use to do more. So instead of selling reinvention, we build the missing piece: the WordPress plugin, the Shopify app, the Odoo module, the browser extension, or the standalone platform that connects them all.
mission: Make dependable, well-crafted software extensions and platforms accessible to businesses of any size.

values.title: Ship what works
values.description: A product is done when it runs reliably in production, not when the demo looks good.

values.title: Respect the platform
values.description: We follow each ecosystem's conventions: WordPress coding standards, Shopify app requirements, Odoo module structure, so our products upgrade cleanly.

values.title: Plain words
values.description: Documentation, pricing and limitations stated clearly. No invented claims, no inflated numbers.
